__baseline_prompt__.text: Make a photographic mecha scene in a small repair workshop: a mechanical subject, a service robot with a constructed body, sits beside a workbench while a short-haired woman repairs its detached arm. Use the supplied portrait for the woman's face and hair appearance; preserve the visible facial proportions, dark eyes, short dark bob and wispy separated fringe. Her absorbed, unforced presence and the soft sheen of her hair keep the human encounter warm within the precise mechanical work. The woman uses a driver on the detached robot arm's wrist fastener while her other hand grips its exposed forearm frame between elbow and wrist. The detached robot arm shows a distinct elbow joint connected through the exposed forearm frame to a separate wrist joint. The arm rests on a shallow padded workbench cradle. Its upper-arm segment angles away from the broad circular elbow hinge, while the long open forearm frame runs across the front of the bench toward the narrower wrist swivel and mechanical hand. The supporting fingertips curl around the lower edge of the near bare frame rail, their skin-to-metal contact visible against the open space within the frame. The driver shaft extends clearly beyond the tool-holding fingers to its tip seated in the upper-facing wrist fastener. Her two forearms approach these separate work points with space between them, each visibly continuous back to its own sleeve. Compose a landscape photograph from a shallow oblique viewpoint above the bench, keeping her face, both hands, the entire detached arm and the robot chassis together. Let the arm occupy the broad lower half of the image so the elbow, supporting contact, driver tip and wrist have distinct readable silhouettes. The robot chassis sits behind the elbow end, separated in depth from the working hands. Broad window light and a quiet neutral workshop background give the exposed metal edges clear contrast; subtle wear, natural skin texture and a plain blue work shirt make this feel like a concentrated, ordinary repair moment.
